sources.title: World Inequality Database (WID.world)
sources.used_for: US pre-tax income and wealth by percentile (127 bins, 1962-2023), adult population, price index, comparison countries, 1928 top shares.
sources.license: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, as marked on WID.world charts. Terms for bulk downloads not separately stated (VERIFICATION.md V8).
sources.citation: World Inequality Database (WID.world), per-country bulk files. US series: Piketty, Saez and Zucman; wealth: Saez and Zucman (2020); European series: Blanchet, Chancel and Gethin.

sources.title: Piketty, Saez and Zucman, Distributional National Accounts for the United States, updated series (February 2022)
sources.used_for: US post-tax disposable cash income by percentile (Table C4b, 1962-2019); checks against Tables B1 and C1b.
sources.license: Not stated on the source page; published by the authors for public use.
sources.citation: Piketty, T., Saez, E. and Zucman, G. (2018). Distributional National Accounts: Methods and Estimates for the United States. Quarterly Journal of Economics 133(2): 553-609. Updated series, February 2022.

sources.title: Auten and Splinter, Income Inequality in the United States: Using Tax Data to Measure Long-term Trends (extension through 2022)
sources.used_for: Alternative pre-tax group shares, 1962-2022 (Table C2, Pre-tax National Income), applied to the PSZ shape.
sources.license: Not stated on the source page; published by the authors for public use.
sources.citation: Auten, G. and Splinter, D. (2024). Income Inequality in the United States: Using Tax Data to Measure Long-term Trends. Journal of Political Economy 132(7). Data extended through 2022.

sources.title: Federal Reserve Board, Distributional Financial Accounts
sources.used_for: Household net worth shares by wealth group, quarterly from 1989 Q3 (history chart only).
sources.citation: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System, Distributional Financial Accounts of the United States.

sources.title: US Bureau of Economic Analysis, National Income and Product Accounts
sources.used_for: Compensation-to-wages ratio and national income (NIPA Table 1.12).
sources.citation: US Bureau of Economic Analysis, NIPA Table 1.12, National Income by Type of Income.

sources.title: IRS Statistics of Income, Individual Income Tax Returns
sources.used_for: Total adjusted gross income for 1953, 1963, 1980 and 2023 (taxable-base ratio in tax mode).
sources.citation: Internal Revenue Service, Statistics of Income: Individual Income Tax Returns (1953, 1963, 1980 reports; Publication 1304 Table 1.1, 2023).

sources.title: IPUMS CPS, Annual Social and Economic Supplement (survey years 1963 and 2024)
sources.used_for: Methods-page panel only (survey vs tax data at the top) and a regression test. Aggregates only; microdata is not published.
sources.license: IPUMS terms of use: no redistribution of microdata; cite IPUMS.
sources.citation: IPUMS CPS, University of Minnesota, www.ipums.org. Extract version to confirm with Adam (VERIFICATION.md V18).

sources.title: Tax Foundation, Historical U.S. Federal Individual Income Tax Rates and Brackets, 1862-2025
sources.used_for: Statutory federal income tax schedules (tax mode).
sources.citation: Tax Foundation, Historical U.S. Federal Individual Income Tax Rates & Brackets, 1862-2025. Downloaded by Adam Lake, October 2026.
